mods.name: USB Hub Support
mods.author: NachoCasta
mods.summary: Hub sources stay available when switching PRO DJ LINK on or off.
mods.description: Browse playlists/tracks and load USB sticks connected through a hub. Version0.3.2 preserves hub sources across PRO DJ LINK On/Off, with owner-reported loaded-track continuity on the physical AZ. Four local decks Off; two local decks On. Hub libraries stay local and are not shared with external CDJs. Native-style HUB labels and individual/whole-hub safe eject are retained; wait for safe-to-remove confirmation. Exact firmware2.00 (ep147-9e9454e357389ece), kernel4.4.194 and core>=1.2.3. Actual-CDJ, phase-sync, eight-source hardware, long-session timing and cache capacity remain unvalidated. A same-process post-eject/replug source-list anomaly recovered after normal reload in the emulator. AZ-MODS stages files internally. The immutable package retains its tested candidate wording.
